// =============================================================================
// ASP.NET Core Integration Regression Test Templates

// Use these templates when test_level is "integration" or "both".
// Integration tests use *IntegrationTests.cs suffix and are placed in
// *.IntegrationTests test projects.
//
// This file contains THREE template variants — use the one matching the
// ASP.NET Core component type under test.
// =============================================================================


// =============================================================================
// VARIANT 1: WebApplicationFactory — Controller Integration Regression
// =============================================================================
// Use for: Controllers, Minimal API endpoints
// Dependencies: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing
// =============================================================================

/// Integration regression tests for <see cref="{{CLASS_NAME}}"/> — {{CHANGE_DESCRIPTION}}

[Trait("Category", "Regression")]

public class {{CLASS_NAME}}IntegrationTests
    : IClassFixture<WebApplicationFactory<Program>>
{
    private readonly HttpClient _client;

    public {{CLASS_NAME}}IntegrationTests(WebApplicationFactory<Program> factory)
    {
        _client = factory.WithWebHostBuilder(builder =>
        {
            builder.ConfigureTestServices(services =>

                // Replace real dependencies with test doubles
                // services.AddScoped<{{DEPENDENCY_INTERFACE_1}}>(sp =>

            });
        }).CreateClient();
    }

    // Nested class for endpoint behavior tests
    [Trait("Category", "Regression")]
    public class EndpointBehaviorTests : {{CLASS_NAME}}IntegrationTests
    {
        public EndpointBehaviorTests(WebApplicationFactory<Program> factory)
            : base(factory) { }

        [Fact(DisplayName = "{{ENDPOINT_METHOD}} {{ENDPOINT_PATH}} still returns expected status")]
        public async Task Endpoint_ValidRequest_ReturnsExpectedStatus()
        {
            // var response = await _client.GetAsync("{{ENDPOINT_PATH}}");

            // var content = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<{{RESPONSE_TYPE}}>();
            // Assert.NotNull(content);
        }

        [Fact(DisplayName = "{{ENDPOINT_PATH}} still returns 404 for non-existent resource")]
        public async Task Endpoint_NotFound_Returns404()
        {
            // var response = await _client.GetAsync("{{ENDPOINT_PATH}}/999");
            // Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.NotFound, response.StatusCode);
        }

        [Fact(DisplayName = "{{ENDPOINT_PATH}} still validates request body")]
        public async Task Endpoint_InvalidBody_Returns400()

            // var response = await _client.PostAsync("{{ENDPOINT_PATH}}", content);

    // Nested class for response structure tests
